en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town square with a large brick church dominating the right side, featuring tall arched windows and a tower with a clock and small spire. In front of the church is an open cobbled square bordered by traditional gabled houses; one central building has an awning and signage. A few people, including children, stand near the buildings. The title "Dommitzsch." is printed at the top left in red, and the publisher credit with date appears at the bottom.
